title: alnus hirsuta
intro: Alnus hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy alder, is a species of deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the family Betulaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Alnus hirsuta include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve digestion, making it a potential remedy for gastrointestinal issues and other inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Alnus hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
